remarks: Tri-level townhouse-style condominium with private entrance and private garage. This desirable end unit offers additional windows for abundant natural light, including a bay window in the spacious open living/dining area. The beautiful eat-in kitchen features stainless steel appliances and a breakfast nook set beside a bay window. Both generously sized bedrooms include full en-suite bathrooms. The lower level offers excellent flexibility, featuring a bonus room with sliders to a walk-out patio-ideal for a home office, media room, gym, or recreation space-along with a large storage room and direct access to the private garage. Silver Ridge provides a tranquil setting while remaining exceptionally convenient for commuters. Walk to the Merritt 7 Train Station with quick access to I-95 and Route 15. Ideally located close to all that Norwalk and the surrounding areas have to offer, including Calf Pasture Beach, Cranbury Park, historic SoNo, public golf courses, schools, shopping, Metro-North stations, major highways, and more. Approximately 50 miles to Midtown Manhattan. Additional features include a reserved parking space directly outside the unit, in-unit laundry, ample storage and pet-friendly living. Agents-please see remarks.
